summary: Iter119 — Dragon Realm Phase 3&4 Full World validation. Backend: 12/12 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_dragon_realm_phase34.py (209s runtime, rate-limits respected). State contract: content.region_order = 6 regions in canonical order; regions[*].dragons totals 36 (6 per region); bosses = 6; dragon_king.multi_phase=true with 2 supports (inferno_head + shadow_head); rewards_config has all 8 keys (quest_complete, dragon_first_defeat, boss_thornbeast/gemnasher/duneblaze/frostwyrm/skytitan/dragon_king). Security: POST /event battle_win with unknown enemy → 400; battle_win into locked region (gemscale w/o forest boss) → 400 'still locked'; boss_win before gate → 400 'boss gate locked'; second event within 4s → 400 'Too fast'. Progression: reset-progress + walked founder through all 6 regions (3 battle_wins + 1 befriend forest + boss_win each), verified trusted.bosses[all 6]=true and trusted.quests[all 6]=true, boss_dragon_king reward created at rewards_config amount 250. Dragon King gate: separate reset test → beat only Forest → tried boss_win castle → 400 rejected ('Dragonfall Castle is still locked' / 'every region boss has fallen'). Claim idempotency: reset+forest completion, recorded FP vault before (906) → claim boss_thornbeast → 200 amount=100, vault+100 exactly → replay same reward_id → 400 'Already claimed' → vault UNCHANGED (no double credit). claim-all endpoint: 200, drained all remaining unclaimed to claimed status. Admin config PUT with rewards={all 8 keys bumped} + reason → 200 all keys persisted → restore → 200 all keys restored. Reset endpoint requires user_id AND reason (400 otherwise). Frontend (1440x1000, live founder session): (a) /admin/games — dr-admin-toggle expands dr-admin-body with all 8 dr-admin-reward-* inputs, dr-admin-enabled checkbox, dr-admin-access-mode select, dr-admin-reset-user + dr-admin-reset-btn + dr-admin-save present. Save workflow: bumped quest_complete 25→26 via UI, window.prompt captured with 'iter119 frontend test', response reflected in the input, restored to 25. Reset-progress: filled stealth uid (e3cd1aab-6009-49f8-ac90-62736509699a) from /api/auth/me, clicked reset, both prompt (reason) and confirm dialogs fired and were accepted, PASS. (b) /games?play=dragonrealm-firequest-v1 — dr-new-game/continue/options/extras/credits and dr-fire-balance (906 Fire Power) all visible on title. Clicking New Game showed dr-world-map with all 6 dr-region-<id> tiles present; enchanted_forest not disabled, the OTHER 5 (crystal_caverns → dragonfall_castle) all have disabled='' attribute (locked) — exactly matches trusted-state expectation for a fresh reset. (c) Mobile 390x844: entered forest, dr-dpad-up/down/left/right all visible. (d) /games hub screenshot shows Dragon Realm: The Fire Quest card alongside Chrono Rift, Neon Tunnel Drift, and other games — hub regression clean, no crash. [game-card-* testid count returned 0 because the hub uses a different testid pattern; card is visibly rendered.] No console errors related to Dragon Realm; 401s printed are pre-login media/asset probes.
action_items: OPTIONAL: hub game-card testid inconsistency — /games renders Dragon Realm card correctly but the outer card wrapper does not carry a data-testid matching game-card-<id>. Non-blocking (playable via ?play=), but next testing agent should discover the actual card testid. Consider adding data-testid='game-card-dragonrealm-firequest-v1' on the hub tile for stable regression selectors.

OPTIONAL (carried over from iter118, still valid): DragonRealmRuntime.jsx L189 Continue button `disabled={!state.save}` — since New Game immediately doSave()s a fresh save, Continue becomes enabled the moment a user clicks New Game once. Consider gating on server trusted-progress non-empty for a stricter 'true first play' UX.
critical_code_review_comments: services/dragon_realm.py::claim_reward L323-328 now stamps 'claimed' BEFORE the settle_due/collect_fire fire-vault-move step (iter118 review addressed). Good. Note: if the initial credit_fire raises AFTER the ledger successfully wrote (e.g. connection blip in response path), the rollback at L317-320 would flip the doc back to unclaimed and idempotency-key replay would re-credit — verified idempotency_key=idem on credit_fire mitigates this by making the second credit a no-op replay. This is safe as tested (test_claim_and_idempotent_second_call).

services/dragon_realm.py::record_event L226-233 the try/except around ISO parsing of last_event_at still catches Exception and silently `pass`es. Corrupt timestamp would skip rate-limiting silently. Consider `log.warning` for observability.

routers/dragon_realm.py::admin_config_put L101 access_mode validation includes 'launch' in ACCESS_MODES? Actually ACCESS_MODES = ('founder_only','custom','beta','live','maintenance'). user_allowed L180 also checks 'live' + 'custom'/'beta'. Consistent — no drift.

DragonRealmAdminPanel.jsx L28-30 PUT body includes eligible_usernames/maintenance_message but NOT eligible_user_ids — if a founder manages user IDs via a future field, they'd need to re-open the config. Minor extensibility note.

engine.js finale finisher unblock (main-agent fixed) — not directly re-tested via UI in this run because reaching phase 4 requires 5 boss defeats + 3 castle dragons in the browser session (>60s of gameplay with 4s rate-limits × ~20 events). Backend confirms boss_dragon_king reward path works via API and idempotent claim, which is the security-critical half. Frontend finale action is unblocked in code (BattleView.jsx uses engine.act which now allows b.over==='finale'); recommend main agent do a quick single-run browser sanity of the finisher click to close the loop end-to-end.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_dragon_realm_phase34.py — takes ~3.5min because rate-limit spacing >4s between events × ~30 events across the progression + king-gate + claim-idempotency tests.
